correctness.rationale: On reflected endpoint alpha=2/L, F(x)=Lx and T=-I, the independent zero-mean noises enter the OHM terminal iterate with coefficients alpha*(j+1)/N in magnitude. Summing squares gives 2nu²(N-1)(2N-1)/(3N). Dual-OHM impulse coefficients at m=N-j are 1/[2(m-1)] for even m and -1/(2m) for odd m, giving exact nu²D_N; parity alternating deterministic terms match. Summing odd reciprocal squares gives D_N -> pi²/4-1. Independently checked low horizons N=2,3 by substitution and coefficients; general result rests on exact induction and series identity.
